meta_data.base_class: Allow booking for selected <themed events> in specific regions - refers to public or private gatherings with specific themes, usually held at certain times or seasons, where participants can reserve attendance.

tool_template.name: <class>_bookEvent
tool_template.description: Allows booking a spot for a selected <class> event in a specified region.

eventName.description: The name of the <class> event to book.

attendeeContact.description: Contact information of the attendee (e.g., email or phone number).

attendeeName.description: The full name of the attendee who will participate in the <class> event.

eventDate.description: The date of the <class> event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

region.description: The geographical location or region where the <class> event will take place.

numberOfAttendees.description: The number of attendees that the booking is being made for at the <class> event.

specialRequirements.description: Any special requirements or accommodations needed for the attendee at the <class> event.

paymentConfirmed.description: Indicates whether payment has been confirmed for the <class> event booking.
